sources.licenseNote: no LICENSE file in the repository root; MIT is stated in the README and in the license field of SKILL.md
sources.method: web_fetch and curl over raw.githubusercontent.com, size and git-blob-SHA1 of each file verified against the source

repository tarball via scripts/fetch-sources.ps1 -Source better-ui; all 65 files of the tree compared against the git-blob-SHA1 of the commit (0 mismatches, 0 extras, 0 missing), then the 11 skill folders copied into this section unchanged

read, then declined. SKILL.md is 123 lines of wrapper around an npm CLI: every step is npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search|retrieve, the package is unpinned, network and npm are required at run time, and the skill itself notes npx may fail on Windows (npx.cmd needed). The 144 guides/ files next to it are the data of that npm package, not reference material SKILL.md reads, so vendoring the folder would add 145 files that nothing loads. Kept in scripts/fetch-sources.ps1 as an on-demand source: fetch-sources.ps1 -Source modern-web
notVendored.reconsideration: the knowledge itself is worth having. If the CLI dependency is acceptable, either vendor the wrapper and record the npm dependency as a deviation, or vendor guides/ alone as reference material and say so in SOURCE.md

notVendored.reason: repository files outside skills/ are not vendored, as in every other set: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md and the plugin manifests describe the source repository, not the skills. No skill of the set was left out
